evidence: This is a wall face terrain strip (32 rows tall). Like the reference Beodeul wall faces, it is a vertical wall surface with a top trim/pipe (rows 0-6), recessed wall panels (rows 7-20) with rivets, pipes, and a vent, and a lower wainscoting/baseboard section (rows 21-31). Valid for kind=terrain.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul timber/plaster and stone walls on the left, the candidate consists of large flat geometric rectangles of uniform blue-grey (e.g., rows 9-18 inside the panels and rows 24-27 along the lower base are solid fills with only a couple of 2-3px horizontal dashes). The orange pipes are straight 2px bands with a single 1px highlight dot. Information density and surface texture are much lower than the reference.
